scan.description: A 1m box oscillates +/-1m along x (period 6s) directly ahead of the radar. The center-beam distance should track it: ~1.5m to ~3.5m, not a static value.

points.description: Point cloud x midpoint should track the same 1.5-3.5m oscillation; the y extent stays roughly the box width (~1m) regardless of range.

image.description: Unlike the static_cpu scenario (office mesh fills most of the FOV, ~100% nonzero via ambient noise), this scene is just one box in open space: most beam angles get no reflection at all, and this port's ambient-noise model scales with the column's own peak signal, so an angle with zero signal renders as pure black rather than a noise floor -- nonzero_ratio ~18% here is expected, not a bug. The center-column return should still track the box's range like the scan does.
